paragraphs: Today is Sam's birthday. He has a new green bike. Tom and Lily come to see it. In the afternoon, they go to the beach. It is a sunny day. Tom has a basketball. They ride their bikes. Lily has a bag with juice. Pip runs next to them.

The sea is blue and the sand is white. "Let's play!" says Tom. He bounces the basketball. It does not bounce. "Oh no!" says Tom. "The ball is not good on sand," says Sam. "What can we do?" asks Lily. Pip sits on the sand and looks at the ball.

Lily looks behind the beach shop. "Look! There is a playground!" It has a basketball board. The children run to the playground. Now the ball bounces. Sam throws the ball and Tom catches it. Pip runs and says, "Woof!" Lily says, "Happy birthday, Sam!" "Thank you!" says Sam. "This is a good birthday."
text.summary: It is Sam's birthday. He rides his new bike to the beach with Tom and Lily, but the basketball does not bounce on sand.
